steps.title: Rearrange tips for 24‑well spacing
steps.instruction: Take a full P300 tip box, remove the tips and redistribute them into two empty P300 tip boxes so that tips occupy every other row, creating a 24‑well spacing compatible layout for the P300/P20 multipipette.

substeps.instruction: Remove tips from the standard‑spaced full tip box.
Place tips into two empty tip boxes, arranging them in alternating rows.

steps.title: Load full tip rack
steps.instruction: Place the full P300 tip rack into slot 10 of the deck.

steps.title: Load empty tip racks
steps.instruction: Place two empty P300 tip racks into slots 4 and 5 of the deck.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Run the experimental protocol using the arranged tip configuration.
